reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in our DM. On Oct 14 he told me his standing call with the Marrow Agrisupply team is Thursdays at 10:45, starting then. I checked his original message before answering.

He never said how long the call runs, so I didn't add anything to his calendar. I offered to add the calls starting Thursday Oct 22 if he tells me the length.

The summary I wrote for you after the Oct 14 reply was also posted into Tobias's DM, so he can see it there. It repeats what he already knew, so nothing private got out.
